beats.what: On the Sydney waterfront Lynn and Bank make peace over his broken nose
Bank tells Lynn he has never been abroad and that from tomorrow he can go anywhere in the world
A news bulletin tells Bank the STIC has been cancelled across Asia because the questions leaked, and that security is being tightened
Officials confiscate every phone and bag at the door before letting the last candidates in
Lynn and Bank take adjoining stalls, retrieve the phone taped inside the toilet and signal to each other through a gap in the partition
Section 1 starts at 8:30 and Lynn works the reading test while Bank memorises the answers
In Thailand Pat and Grace wait at the printing house with students and motorbike couriers ready to run the answers out
At the ten-minute break both unwrap the hidden phones and start thumbing the Section 1 answer strings into the chat
Bank stops sending and demands another million baht, transferred within five minutes
Bank prices the second million as payment for the beating he took, and Pat wires everything left in the account with the rest due on delivery
The answers are turned into barcode strips printed onto pencils and handed out to the waiting students
Lynn and Bank sit Sections 2 and 3, then at the next break Bank sends the answers and grid-in values while Lynn keeps watch
Proctors enter the washroom saying Bank has been reported for staying out too long
Bank deletes the chat thread and flushes the phone away as the proctors close in, while Lynn climbs out over her cistern
An official seizes Bank in the corridor demanding to know what he did, with Lynn watching from the doorway
